name: controlled hierarchy and timing study
status: development experiment; no claim of untouched final validation
source_rule: Frozen final LinUCB scoring with its final alpha on one common fixed candidate bank: default plus union of all four saved elite sets plus uniformly drawn arms to 2048. No outcomes, history updates or RNG draws during recommendation.
calibration_source: Default setup, fixed w=1, independent fresh inputs; no trained selector required
sigma_rule: 75th percentile of sample SDs of repeated identical fixed-w=1 physical costs within each calibration input; a development heuristic, not a universal noise bound. Charge the full calibration cost once to each near-tie logical run.
baseline_selection: Per hierarchy source, lexicographically minimize final failure count then total solve/control/recovery cost on selection inputs. Keep every held-out input, including failures.
frozen_rule: Preserve LSTDQ v3 LCB beta=2, learn=false, explore=false; fresh native environment for every policy and matching pre-cycle A/P/R/RHS/x fingerprints
online_interpretation: One development training trajectory on fresh inputs; conditional online payback given an externally supplied frozen hierarchy source. Not an estimate of training-repeat uncertainty.
robustness_stream: Reuse exact 56700120 development inputs and original setup/controller initial seeds; two separately initialized execution repetitions, explicitly requested after discarding the invalid initial timing runs. Each variant is a complete joint branch with RL from input 1001. Development screening only, not evidence of a precise variance reduction.
native_execution: Sequential, single thread, AC power, four predefined warmup inputs before each phase (recorded separately, excluded from algorithm cost); randomized policy order per input
accounting: Solve-control cost includes native solve, policy dispatch/features/inference/update/lifecycle and all fallback work. Paired logical end-to-end totals add the same mean primary setup measurement and source decision cost to every policy. Also preserve actually measured physical totals. Hierarchy hashing, telemetry, file/checkpoint IO and matrix assembly outside existing timers are audit/harness work, reported separately from the algorithm metric.
